notes.title: 99 Anime Girls - Prerelease Update
notes.content:
Dear gamers, thank you for considering my upcoming game "99 Anime Girls". This is a brief update of where things are currently at and some of my thoughts and to do's.

The game is set for a mid-April release. I am currently testing some of the latter levels and fixing up small bugs where I find them, but everything is looking great! My main focus now is marketing and promotion and first up I would really like to make a new game trailer as I realize the current one is not that great! I feel like my video editing skills are quite lacking being a one-man indie. Therefore if anyone has the ability to make a cool game trailer and wants to help me, please message me, otherwise I'll just do my best and try and make another one.

Also, if I have time I would also like to implement some steam specific features such as leader boards, achievements etc. While my game already has those it would be nice to link them to the steam infrastructure.

Lastly, I wanted to welcome anyone wishlisting or otherwise watching this game. Feel free to ask me any questions about the game or otherwise comment on whatever. Get excited! Thanks!
